† [נָחַץ] vb. urge (?), whence (si vera l.);—
Qal Pt. pass. (active Pt. in u, according to BaNB 175), דְּבַר הַמֶּלֶךְ נָחוּץ 1 S 21:9 the king’s business was urgent (𝔊 κατὰ σπουδήν, A κατασπεῦδον). (Thes cp. Arabic نَحَضَ ursit instititque rogando [Kam. Frey]); text dub.; HPS נָאוֹץ (from אוץ), > נחושׁ.
